Re-check when the docs toolchain drops the dependency or a fixed image-size ships.

GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv.reason: node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw (CVE-2026-85393). The monorepo already pins node-forge to 1.4.0 because @parse/node-apn@6.5.0 hard-codes the vulnerable 1.3.1 dependency; the advisory currently has no patched upstream version. The dependency is used by the APNs transport package, and the pin must remain until @parse/node-apn relaxes its exact dependency or node-forge publishes a fixed release. Re-check on dependency/toolchain updates and remove this exception when a fixed version is available.
